content:
maria_sales: Hey team — ACME Corp just flagged vendor risk as a hard blocker. They need a data flow diagram showing EU data residency controls, a current subprocessor roster, and confirmation on where logs/metrics live. Can we get a slim package for their security team by EOD tomorrow?

sam_solutions: I can assemble the DFD and subprocessor list. Quick clarification: do they require strict EU-only processing (no cross-border backups) or just EU-at-rest?

maria_sales: They said EU-only processing for customer data and no backups outside EU for PII. Metrics/telemetry can be aggregated but must be anonymized and stored in EU.

sam_solutions: Understood. I'll prepare: 1) a one-page DFD highlighting network boundaries, KMS/HSM for keys, and where KV cache is persisted; 2) a CSV of subprocessors with data category columns; 3) a short note on logging/metrics retention.

leo_security: Heads-up: for EU-only processing we should offer Private (VPC) deployment or Dedicated with region pinning. Hosted API has multi-region fallbacks by default — legal will flag that. If we propose Hosted, include explicit routing policy and no-fallback config snippet.

chris_legal: If you propose Private or Dedicated, include the subprocessors for infra and support (e.g., cloud provider, monitoring, observability vendor). Provide contract verbiage for subprocessor notification/approval. I can draft the legal clause once we have the list.

sam_solutions: Drafting now. Adding minimal example of config to pin region:```yaml
routing:
  region_preference: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
  fallback: false
  storage:
    kv_cache_region: eu-central-1
    backups: disabled
```

sam_solutions: Subprocessors (high level):
- Cloud infra: GCP (europe-west3) for Dedicated/Private infra or GCP EU zones for Hosted EU deployments
- Monitoring: Datadog (EU tenant)
- Logging pipeline: internal ELK (s3 EU bucket) / or managed equivalent
- KMS: customer-managed KMS (recommended) + Redwood KMS (HSM-backed) for key escrow policies
- Support provider: Zendesk (EU data residency enabled)

leo_security: Add that metrics are aggregated and pseudonymized before leaving region. Also: Redis KV cache persisted only when Dedicated/Private; Hosted uses ephemeral in-memory cache unless customer requests EU-persistent cache.

maria_sales: Great. Can you also give a one-paragraph answer for their SIG/CAIQ question about network segmentation and encryption? They want a short answer we can paste into the questionnaire.

sam_solutions: Sure. Short draft: "Redwood enforces encryption in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Network segmentation is applied at the tenant level for Dedicated and Private deployments; Hosted runs per-tenant logical isolation with VPC peering options and strict routing policies. Customer-managed KMS is supported for key sovereignty; audit logs and access controls are available via the Console with export to EU storage endpoints."

chris_legal: Looks fine. I'd tweak to mention SOC2 and ISO controls we map to CAIQ entries — but keep it brief for the customer. I can attach a compliance mapping later.

redwood-bot: document uploaded: /internal/security/assets/eu-dataflow-template-v2.png (sha256:abcdef123456)

sam_solutions: Uploaded initial DFD (see redwood-bot link). I'm going to export a CSV of subprocessors and a 1-page answers doc for SIG/CAIQ fields. ETA ~6 hours.

maria_sales: Thanks — can you also include rough pricing delta for Private vs Hosted for their expected RPS (50 req/s) so procurement can budget? Even a +/-30% is okay.

sam_solutions: Quick thumb: Hosted with EU region pin + reserved burst would be cheapest TCO but may not meet their no-cross-border rule. Dedicated capacity (EU-only) ~ +45% vs hosted list price for committed monthly seat that meets latency and isolation. Private on-prem varies; add setup + support onboarding. I'll add a short pricing note.

leo_security: Also state that backup retention outside EU is disabled in the proposed configuration; add KMS rotation policy and access control note: "keys held by customer; Redwood maintains split escrow only if contractually required".

maria_sales: Perfect. Once you have the bundle (DFD PNG, subprocessors CSV, SIG answer doc, pricing note), drop into this thread and I'll forward to the customer security contact. Appreciate fast turnaround. :pray:

sam_solutions: Will do. Adding checklist to thread so we don't miss items:
- [x] Confirm EU-only requirement
- [ ] DFD PNG (to upload)
- [ ] Subprocessor CSV (to upload)
- [ ] SIG/CAIQ short answers doc
- [ ] Pricing delta note
- [ ] Legal subprocessor clause draft (chris_legal)

chris_legal: I'll review the subprocessor CSV when it's posted and propose a notification clause. If they need data processing addendum (DPA) updates, we'll handle it in parallel.

maria_sales: Thanks all — looping @ACME-security (external) in follow-up email after we post the artefacts here.

sam_solutions: Posting artefacts here once ready. ETA ~5.5 hrs."
